Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick intro from the AE team — VerdantData is seeing renewed interest in adding LLM-powered automation into our Ops workflows, and our VP of Ops (Mark Stanton) along with our CIO (Jenna Liu) want a short, exec-level briefing before we commit to a technical deep-dive.

Would your team be able to run a 25–30 minute executive overview the week of Aug 12? Evening windows work best for our execs due to travel — we were hoping for an evening slot (US West) around 6:00–7:30pm PT on either Aug 14 or Aug 16. High-level asks:
- 10–12 minute strategic overview (latency/cost footprint & hosting options)
- 10–12 minute Q&A focused on security/compliance and dedicated/private deployment
- A short follow-up mutual action plan and next steps

If you can propose a concrete time and an agenda, I can lock the execs. Important note: Jenna prefers a short briefing with a named backup in case she gets pulled — we may nominate the SVP of Infrastructure as delegate.

Thanks — 
Emily Carter
